title: Convergence of integrals from limsup on compact sets and liminf on bounded open sets
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let μ and μ_j (j ∈ ℕ) be Borel measures on ℝ^P (Measure (Euclid P)). Assume (a) μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P; (b) limsup_j μ_j(K) ≤ μ(K) for every compact K; (c) μ(G) ≤ liminf_j μ_j(G) for every bounded open G ⊆ ℝ^P (lim sup and lim inf taken in [0, ∞]). Then for every continuous f : ℝ^P → ℝ with compact support, ∫ f dμ_j → ∫ f dμ (Bochner integrals).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → limsup (fun j => μs j K) atTop ≤ μ K) → (∀ G : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen G → Bornology.IsBounded G → μ G ≤ liminf (fun j => μs j G) atTop) → ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, f x ∂(μs j)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, f x ∂μ))
